name: Troll, Swamp
languages: Giant Foul-smelling lurkers of bogs and swamps, ambushing prey from the mire.
description: Foul-smelling lurkers of bogs and swamps, ambushing prey from the mire.

abilities.name: Lob
abilities.description: Swamp Trolls may make a slam attack as if using a thrown weapon. Additionally, they may use their Str modifier in place of their Agi modifier when doing so.

abilities.name: Lurk
abilities.description: Swamp Troll’s are better at naturally blending into their surroundings. When in a freshwater environment, swamp trolls treat Stealth as a trained skill and ignore any size penalties to their Stealth checks.

abilities.name: Regrow
abilities.description: When a swamp troll loses a limb, they can grow it back in 1d10+1 days, at which point any penalties are removed.

loot: Stardust (5%), Fae Wood (20%), Earth Crystal (50%), Magicite (95%)

name: Ogre
languages: Giant Savage and violent, these hulking brutes often join orcs and goblins in inland raids.
description: Savage and violent, these hulking brutes often join orcs and goblins in inland raids.

abilities.name: Overthrow
abilities.description: Whenever an ogre successfully deals damage to a target at the end of a charge, they may choose to move the target 3 squares away from them in any direction. This is a stun.

loot: Gigas Heart (5%), Bronze Chestplate (20%), Oaken Club (50%), Giant Hide (95%), and 300gp
steal: Ether (5%), Hi-Potion (95%) Giants Remnants of a more primitive age before civilizations flourished, giants once held dominion over the lesser tribes, contested only by the great dragons. While still widely feared, most see the giants as little more than oversized brutes that even the lowly Goblins can bring under their meager command. Giants progress as beasts. However, they have the class skills of a nonheroic character and gain 2 attribute points every 4th level, as normal.

name: Troll, Rock
languages: Giant Mountain-dwelling brutes that skulk along cliffside paths, waiting to strike unwary prey.
description: Mountain-dwelling brutes that skulk along cliffside paths, waiting to strike unwary prey.

abilities.name: Lob
abilities.description: Rock Trolls may make a slam attack as if using a thrown weapon. Additionally, they may use their Str modifier in place of their Agi modifier when doing so.

abilities.name: Lurk
abilities.description: Rock Trolls are better at naturally blending into their surroundings. When in caves or mountains, rock trolls treat Stealth as a trained skill and ignore any size penalties to their Stealth checks.

abilities.name: Regrow
abilities.description: When a rock troll loses a limb, they can grow it back in 1d10+1 days, at which point any penalties are removed.

loot: Obsidian (20%), Giant Hide (50%), Earth Crystal (95%), and 200gp

name: Cyclops
languages: Giant To meet a cyclops’s gaze is to invite ruin—a curse whispered through ancient tales.
description: To meet a cyclops’s gaze is to invite ruin—a curse whispered through ancient tales.

abilities.name: Eye Beam
abilities.description: As a primary action, the cyclops can make a single attack roll (d20+23) against a target within 12 squares and line of sight and all creatures between it and the target. If successful, the target takes 6d6+13 electric damage. Should the attack beat both a target's Ref and Fort Defence, the target becomes paralysed. The cyclops may not use this ability again for 1d4+1 turns.

abilities.name: Imposing
abilities.description: A cyclops may add its Str modifier to all Persuasion checks made to intimidate.

steal: Stardust (5%), Hi-potion (50%) * When using Persuasion to intimidate.

name: Troll, Ice
languages: Giant Dubbed abominable snowmen, these towering brutes may seem jolly—until it’s far too late.
description: Dubbed abominable snowmen, these towering brutes may seem jolly—until it’s far too late.

abilities.name: Frostbite
abilities.description: An ice troll’s slam attack deals cold damage. Additionally, if the attack roll beats both the target's Ref and Fort Defence, the target’s movement is reduced to 2 squares until the start of the ice troll's next turn.

abilities.name: Lob
abilities.description: Ice Trolls may make a slam attack as if using a thrown weapon. Additionally, they may use their Str modifier in place of their Agi modifier when doing so.

abilities.name: Lurk
abilities.description: Trolls are naturally better blending into their surroundings. When in tundra, taiga, or glacial environment, Ice Trolls treat Stealth as a trained skill and ignore any size penalties to their Stealth checks.

abilities.name: Regrow
abilities.description: When a ice troll loses a limb, they can grow it back in 1d10+1 days, at which point any penalties are removed.

loot: Ancient Bone (5%), Giant Hide (50%), Ice Crystal (95%), and 400gp
steal: Magick Root (50%) * Includes 3 points of mighty strikes. **With Lurk.

name: Gigas
languages: Giant Enormous and blood-rune-covered, this powerful giant resists magick’s touch.
description: Enormous and blood-rune-covered, this powerful giant resists magick’s touch.

abilities.name: Devour
abilities.description: Whenever a gigas reduces a creature to 0 HP or the bottom of the Break Gauge with its bite attack, the creature is immediately swallowed, killed (regardless of hero points), and removed from play. The gigas then immediately heals an amount of HP equal to the swallowed creature’s (level + Vit modifier) x2. Additionally, as a primary action, the gigas may perform a coup de grace on an unconscious creature, devouring the creature.

abilities.name: Imposing
abilities.description: A Gigas may add its Str modifier to any Persuasion checks made to intimidate.

abilities.name: Runic
abilities.description: The gigas gains a +5 bonus to both its Fort and Will Defence against spells.

abilities.name: Tremor
abilities.description: As a primary action, the gigas can make an attack roll (d20+21) against the Ref Defence of all creatures within a 6 square cone. If successful, creatures take 6d6+11 blunt damage and are knocked prone. Otherwise, creatures take half damage and are not knocked prone. The gigas may not use this ability again for 1d4+1 turns. This does not affect creatures with hover. This is an area affect and the secondary effect is a stun.

steal: Stardust (5%), Giant Hide (95%) * Against spells. ** Includes 3 points of mighty strikes. † When using Persuasion to intimidate.

name: Jotun
languages: Giant Ancient giants of Jorunheim’s northern wastes, a looming threat to dwarves. Some say they’re kin to the mythic Nephilim.

abilities.name: Frostbite
abilities.description: A jotun’s natural attacks deal cold damage. Additionally, if the attack roll beats both the target's Ref and Fort Defence, the target’s movement is reduced to 2 squares until the start of the jotun's next turn.

abilities.name: Ice Beam
abilities.description: As a primary action, the jotun can make a single attack roll (d20+25) against a target within 12 squares and line of sight and all creatures between it and the target.
